definitions.explanation: A stinging insect related to bees.

examples.english: I was stung by a bee.

examples.japanese: {蜜蜂|みつばち}が{花|はな}に{止|と}まっている。
examples.english: A honeybee is sitting on a flower.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}が{庭|にわ}の{花|はな}の{間|あいだ}を{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: Bees are flying around among the flowers in the garden.

examples.japanese: {蜂蜜|はちみつ}は{蜜蜂|みつばち}が{花|はな}の{蜜|みつ}を{集|あつ}めて{作|つく}る{甘|あま}い{食|た}べ{物|もの}だ。
examples.english: Honey is a sweet food that honeybees make by gathering nectar from flowers.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{田舎|いなか}で{養蜂|ようほう}をしていて、{毎年|まいとし}おいしい{蜂蜜|はちみつ}を{送|おく}ってくれる。
examples.english: My grandfather does beekeeping in the countryside and sends us delicious honey every year.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}の{巣|す}を{見|み}つけた。
{雀蜂|すずめばち}は{刺|さ}されると{危険|きけん}だ。
{軒下|のきした}に{蜂|はち}の{巣|す}ができていたので、{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{取|と}ってもらった。
examples.english: A wasp nest had formed under the eaves, so I had a professional remove it.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}を{歩|ある}いていたら{足長蜂|あしながばち}が{近|ちか}づいてきたので、{静|しず}かにその{場|ば}を{離|はな}れた。
examples.english: A paper wasp came close while I was hiking in the mountains, so I quietly moved away.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{雀蜂|すずめばち}が{攻撃的|こうげきてき}になるので、{山|やま}に{入|はい}るときは{黒|くろ}い{服|ふく}を{避|さ}けて{注意|ちゅうい}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: Hornets become aggressive in autumn, so when going into the mountains, it's best to avoid dark clothing and be careful.

notes:
{蜂|はち} is a general term for bees and wasps.

TYPES OF BEES/WASPS:
- {蜜蜂|みつばち}: honeybee
- {雀蜂|すずめばち}: hornet (Japanese giant hornet)
- {足長蜂|あしながばち}: paper wasp
- {熊蜂|くまばち}: carpenter bee

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {蜂|はち}に{刺|さ}される: to be stung by a bee/wasp
- {蜂|はち}の{巣|す}: beehive, wasp nest
- {蜂蜜|はちみつ}: honey
- {養蜂|ようほう}: beekeeping

SAFETY NOTE:
{雀蜂|すずめばち} (Asian giant hornets) can be very dangerous. Their stings can be life-threatening, especially with multiple stings or allergic reactions.

IDIOM:
{蜂|はち}の{巣|す}をつついたよう: like poking a hornet's nest (causing an uproar).
